classification_challenges: Scattered vector distribution makes boundary detection difficult - vector content is not concentrated in contiguous regions

notes: Simulates PDF forms where the layout is scanned but fillable fields are vector overlays. Tests scattered vector extraction patterns common in government and business forms.
